_about: What signed-out visitors and guests see (the snapshot) and what the database is seeded with. Articles follow db/schema.json → wiki. Write in English as the base language and add i18n.sv/es/de, or write only in Swedish and set lang 'sv' in house.json.

articles.title: The house at a glance
articles.body:
An invented example house: a one-and-a-half-storey timber villa with a detached garage.

Replace this text with your own: when the house was built, by whom, what it is like.

sv.title: Huset i korthet
sv.body:
Ett påhittat exempelhus: en timrad villa i ett och ett halvt plan med fristående garage.

Byt den här texten mot er egen: när huset byggdes, av vem, hur det är.

articles.title: Kitchen
articles.body: Describe the kitchen: appliances (brand, model), worktop, when it was renovated.

sv.title: Kök
sv.body: Beskriv köket: vitvaror (märke, modell), bänkskiva, när det renoverades.
